generic_search_reduction.description: a standard search improvement -- merging equal states -- with no learned representation

memoisation_reduction.description: the same route again with the caches left warm

attribution.reading: `representation_reduction` is the only column that belongs to the learned representation. A large total with a small representation column means the saving was already available without it.

representation_reduction.description: the learned representation, on top of all of the above

attribution.sense: each rung is a separate run of the same task. The step from one rung to the next is credited to that rung and to nothing else, so the four causes are measured rather than apportioned

definitions.compute_break_even_reuse_count: reuses until the acquisition primitive calls are repaid, measured against the naive route
definitions.compute_break_even_reuse_count_against_b: the same, measured against the strongest route available WITHOUT this representation. This is the honest one wherever such a route exists, and it is absent when the representation saves nothing over it
definitions.description_break_even_task_count: tasks until the bits of the representation are repaid by the bits it saves per task
definitions.total_break_even_reuse_count: the later of the compute and description break-evens -- the MAXIMUM, deliberately. Not a sum and not a weighted blend, because bits and calls have no exchange rate

checks.name: observable

certificate_scope.sense: a check of kind `proof` holds for every state; one of kind `no counterexample within depth` holds only as far as it was searched, and says how far

against_best_baseline.sense: the execution graph of the run WITHOUT the representation, minus the graph of the run WITH it. `complete` is false when the node census hit its cap, in which case the counts are a lower bound

against_naive.sense: the execution graph of the run WITHOUT the representation, minus the graph of the run WITH it. `complete` is false when the node census hit its cap, in which case the counts are a lower bound

provenance.node_identity: nodes are keyed by primitive kind, the instrument they were counted at, and a short signature of the call, so a node that survived under another name is not counted as removed
provenance.sense: which computation nodes stopped happening. Both are kept: `against_naive` is the whole difference from the obvious route, `against_best_baseline` is the part that would still have been executed by the strongest route available WITHOUT this representation -- which is the one that answers what having this representation saved

search_reduction.units: candidates_generated counts what was expanded -- words on the naive rung, distinct raw states on the generic rung, distinct observation vectors on the represented one. search_nodes counts state updates against matrix actions. rejected_candidates is in WORDS on every rung, because the merging rungs carry the multiplicity

sequential_depth_reduction.not_a_success_condition: a ratio at or below 1 is recorded, not penalised: an acquisition that costs more depth and repays it over later problems is the case worth keeping, and the break-evens are where that is read

attribution.reading: `representation_reduction` is the only column that belongs to the learned representation. A large total with a small representation column means the saving was already available without it.

representation_reduction.description: the learned representation, on top of all of the above

attribution.sense: each rung is a separate run of the same task. The step from one rung to the next is credited to that rung and to nothing else, so the four causes are measured rather than apportioned

definitions.compute_break_even_reuse_count: reuses until the acquisition primitive calls are repaid, measured against the naive route
definitions.compute_break_even_reuse_count_against_b: the same, measured against the strongest route available WITHOUT this representation. This is the honest one wherever such a route exists, and it is absent when the representation saves nothing over it
definitions.description_break_even_task_count: tasks until the bits of the representation are repaid by the bits it saves per task
definitions.total_break_even_reuse_count: the later of the compute and description break-evens -- the MAXIMUM, deliberately. Not a sum and not a weighted blend, because bits and calls have no exchange rate

checks.name: observable
checks.scope: every state, not only the reachable ones

certificate_scope.sense: a check of kind `proof` holds for every state; one of kind `no counterexample within depth` holds only as far as it was searched, and says how far

against_best_baseline.sense: the execution graph of the run WITHOUT the representation, minus the graph of the run WITH it. `complete` is false when the node census hit its cap, in which case the counts are a lower bound

against_naive.sense: the execution graph of the run WITHOUT the representation, minus the graph of the run WITH it. `complete` is false when the node census hit its cap, in which case the counts are a lower bound

provenance.node_identity: nodes are keyed by primitive kind, the instrument they were counted at, and a short signature of the call, so a node that survived under another name is not counted as removed
provenance.sense: which computation nodes stopped happening. Both are kept: `against_naive` is the whole difference from the obvious route, `against_best_baseline` is the part that would still have been executed by the strongest route available WITHOUT this representation -- which is the one that answers what having this representation saved

search_reduction.units: candidates_generated counts what was expanded -- words on the naive rung, distinct raw states on the generic rung, distinct observation vectors on the represented one. search_nodes counts state updates against matrix actions. rejected_candidates is in WORDS on every rung, because the merging rungs carry the multiplicity

sequential_depth_reduction.not_a_success_condition: a ratio at or below 1 is recorded, not penalised: an acquisition that costs more depth and repays it over later problems is the case worth keeping, and the break-evens are where that is read

definitions.compute_break_even_reuse_count: reuses until the acquisition primitive calls are repaid, measured against the naive route

representation_reduction.description: the learned representation, on top of all of the above

attribution.sense: each rung is a separate run of the same task. The step from one rung to the next is credited to that rung and to nothing else, so the four causes are measured rather than apportioned

definitions.compute_break_even_reuse_count: reuses until the acquisition primitive calls are repaid, measured against the naive route
definitions.compute_break_even_reuse_count_against_b: the same, measured against the strongest route available WITHOUT this representation. This is the honest one wherever such a route exists, and it is absent when the representation saves nothing over it
definitions.description_break_even_task_count: tasks until the bits of the representation are repaid by the bits it saves per task
definitions.total_break_even_reuse_count: the later of the compute and description break-evens -- the MAXIMUM, deliberately. Not a sum and not a weighted blend, because bits and calls have no exchange rate

generic_search_reduction.description: a standard search improvement -- merging equal states -- with no learned representation

memoisation_reduction.description: the same route again with the caches left warm

attribution.reading: `representation_reduction` is the only column that belongs to the learned representation. A large total with a small representation column means the saving was already available without it.

representation_reduction.description: the learned representation, on top of all of the above

attribution.sense: each rung is a separate run of the same task. The step from one rung to the next is credited to that rung and to nothing else, so the four causes are measured rather than apportioned

definitions.compute_break_even_reuse_count: reuses until the acquisition primitive calls are repaid, measured against the naive route
definitions.compute_break_even_reuse_count_against_b: the same, measured against the strongest route available WITHOUT this representation. This is the honest one wherever such a route exists, and it is absent when the representation saves nothing over it
definitions.description_break_even_task_count: tasks until the bits of the representation are repaid by the bits it saves per task
definitions.total_break_even_reuse_count: the later of the compute and description break-evens -- the MAXIMUM, deliberately. Not a sum and not a weighted blend, because bits and calls have no exchange rate

certificate_scope.sense: a check of kind `proof` holds for every state; one of kind `no counterexample within depth` holds only as far as it was searched, and says how far

against_best_baseline.sense: the execution graph of the run WITHOUT the representation, minus the graph of the run WITH it. `complete` is false when the node census hit its cap, in which case the counts are a lower bound

against_naive.sense: the execution graph of the run WITHOUT the representation, minus the graph of the run WITH it. `complete` is false when the node census hit its cap, in which case the counts are a lower bound

provenance.node_identity: nodes are keyed by primitive kind, the instrument they were counted at, and a short signature of the call, so a node that survived under another name is not counted as removed
provenance.sense: which computation nodes stopped happening. Both are kept: `against_naive` is the whole difference from the obvious route, `against_best_baseline` is the part that would still have been executed by the strongest route available WITHOUT this representation -- which is the one that answers what having this representation saved

search_reduction.units: candidates_generated counts what was expanded -- words on the naive rung, distinct raw states on the generic rung, distinct observation vectors on the represented one. search_nodes counts state updates against matrix actions. rejected_candidates is in WORDS on every rung, because the merging rungs carry the multiplicity

sequential_depth_reduction.not_a_success_condition: a ratio at or below 1 is recorded, not penalised: an acquisition that costs more depth and repays it over later problems is the case worth keeping, and the break-evens are where that is read
